name: mapcn
summary: Copy-paste map components for React built on MapLibre GL, styled with Tailwind and installed with the shadcn CLI.
description: Free, ready-to-use map components for React that follow the shadcn model: copy-paste code you own with sensible defaults. The docs list Map, Controls, Markers, Popups, Routes, Arcs, GeoJSON and Clusters; components are theme-aware (light/dark), zero-config and TypeScript, built on MapLibre GL with Tailwind. Basemaps use CARTO over OpenStreetMap data — commercial use needs a CARTO licence, or swap in OpenStreetMap, MapTiler or Stadia tiles. MIT licensed.
